translation: Bitter in flavor, slightly warm, non-toxic. It treats moxibustion for all diseases, can be made into a decoction, stops dysentery with discharge, vomiting of blood, lower-body sores, women's leaking blood (漏血), benefits the genitals (陰), produces flesh, wards off wind and cold, and causes people to have children. One name is Bingtai (冰台), one name is Yicao (醫草).
